title: check-verification-forwards
responsibility: Validates that deprecated verification compatibility forwards remain registered, preserve their UIDs, and resolve to existing canonical targets.

inputs.name: checkVerificationForwards.root
inputs.description: Repository root containing the forward registry, compatibility modules, and canonical target files.

outputs.name: checkVerificationForwards
outputs.description: List of human-readable registry, target, UID, resolution, or discovery issues; an empty list means all discovered forwards satisfy these checks.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Unexpected filesystem failures during source or target inspection can throw; missing/invalid registry data is returned as issue text.
